title: Eventual finite generation from a fixed finite affine section cover
statement: Let X be a compact separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let M be an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and G a finite type quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let I be a finite index type and s_i : O_X -> M global sections. Suppose the opens U_i = X minus the support of Z(s_i) [def-pc-zero-scheme] are affine and cover X. Then there is K in N such that for every k>=K, G tensor M^k [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] has a finite family of global generating sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], equivalently an epimorphic evaluation map from a finite free sheaf. This is only the fixed-degree local-generator extension argument; no ampleness or residue-class assertion is assumed.

proof.text: For each section open U_i prove Module.Finite of Gamma(U_i,G) directly. Take Mathlib finite-type local generators q, refine their cover inside U_i by basic opens D(g), and map each finite generating family along overEquiv and restriction to Spec Gamma(D(g),O_X). Quasi-coherence makes the tilde counit an isomorphism. The proved finite_sections_top_of_isIso_fromTildeΓ and finite_sections_of_finite_sections_restrict_fromSpec in QuasicoherentKernel give finite sections on D(g). These g span the unit ideal; isLocalizedModule_basicOpen and Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan' descend finiteness to U_i. This is the fully proved private finite_sections_of_finiteType helper (the forward finite-section argument of Stacks 01PB), adapted from the already proved private helper in QuasicoherentFiniteTypeAffine. Use Module.Finite.exists_fin to choose t_ij spanning Gamma(U_i,G). No finite-type restriction instance or full affine global-generation theorem is needed.

Install the sheaf-level invertibility instance using IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible. Apply exists_tensorPowSection_eq_restrict over the terminal affine scheme to every t_ij. This gives exponents a_ij and lifts v_ij. The finite sigma index J is Sigma i, ULift (Fin (r i)). Let K = Finset.univ.sup a, which is zero if J is empty. Each a_ij is at most K. All choices are local to a proof of a proposition, with no new definition choosing data from a holed theorem.

For k >= K define w_ij by mulTensorPowSection (s_i) G a_ij (k-a_ij) applied to v_ij, followed by eqToHom for a_ij+(k-a_ij)=k. Naturality of Hom.app and the proved mulTensorPowSection_app_tmulSection show w_ij restricted to U_i equals t_ij tensor tensorPowSectionOne s_i k U_i. The private equality-transport lemma is proved by equality induction. These are only the existing ClearDenominators tensor-power identities, including k=0.

Use restrictions of w_ij to form compatible global sections and their free-sheaf evaluation map phi. The proved isQuasicoherent_tensorObj and IsInvertible.tensorPow in ProjectionFormula give quasi-coherence of its target; these specialize local triviality of an invertible module and preserve all hypotheses. On each U_i, isFreeGenerator_app_one_of_le and isFreeGenerator_tensorPowSectionOne show that tensoring by s_i^k is bijective on sections. Express its preimage as a finite linear combination of t_ij. The same combination of the free basis sections maps to the given target section, by sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection, the restriction identity from Step 3, and linearity of tmulSection. Thus phi is surjective on sections on every U_i. Apply the already proved epi_of_surjective_app to the affine cover, then package phi and the finite index J as finite GeneratingSections. Finite sums over empty index types and Finset.sup require no exceptions.

theorem exists_finite_generatingSections_tensorPow_of_affine_section_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    (M G : X.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] [G.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsFiniteType]
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] (s : I → (𝟙_ X.Modules ⟶ M))
    (haff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Hom.zeroLocus (s i)).support.compl)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, (Hom.zeroLocus (s i)).support.compl) = ⊤) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k →
      ∃ σ : (tensorObj G (M.tensorPow k)).GeneratingSections, σ.IsFiniteType
